## A commuting triangle {#sec-triangle}

The same TikZ source is used for the PDF figure and the HTML image in
@fig-triangle.

::: {#fig-triangle}

```{tikz}
\begin{tikzcd}
  A \arrow[r, "f"] \arrow[dr, "g \circ f"'] & B \arrow[d, "g"] \\
  & C
\end{tikzcd}
```

A commuting triangle.
:::

## Clipping paths {#sec-clipping}

@fig-square and @fig-circle use different clipping paths on the same page.

::: {#fig-square}

```{tikz}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \clip (-1,-1) rectangle (1,1);
  \fill[blue!60] (-1.5,-1.5) rectangle (1.5,1.5);
\end{tikzpicture}
```

A square clipping path.
:::

::: {#fig-circle}

```{tikz}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \clip (0,0) circle (1);
  \fill[orange!80] (-1.5,-1.5) rectangle (1.5,1.5);
\end{tikzpicture}
```

A circular clipping path.
:::
